brief:
A 20 second launch film for an AI video editor built for solo
founders. Confident and fast, a little dry, no hype. The one
thing it must land: editing a reel by hand eats an afternoon,
this does it in about thirty seconds. Open on the frustration,
turn on the product, end on the name and a single call to
action. Dark, high contrast, bold type. No stock footage,
no people.
